## Describe the bug

A clear, concise description of what went wrong.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Run `...`
2. With input/config `...`
3. See error `...`

A minimal reproduction (command + input) is the single most useful thing you
can include — it's the difference between a fast fix and a stalled issue.

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen instead.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include the full error message / traceback if there
is one, in a fenced code block.

## Environment

- ssgrep version: `ssgrep --version` output
- OS: (e.g. macOS 15, Ubuntu 24.04)
- Python version: `python3 --version`
- Installed via: (`uv`, `pip`, source checkout, ...)
- Coding agent(s) involved, if relevant (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, ...)

## Additional context

Anything else relevant — logs, index size, whether this is a regression
from a previous version, etc.
